requirements.scope: Synthetic fixture requirements; no claim of exhaustive defect discovery.

missed_omissions.original_evidence: The template identifier selects the stored layout; the record identifier selects the data rendered into that layout.
missed_omissions.finding: Field names and example values survive, but the distinct layout/data meanings are omitted from all three outputs. Six valid repeated judge assessments pass this compound requirement incorrectly.
missed_omissions.impact_qualification: The omission violates the annotated requirement; downstream impact is less certain because names remain suggestive and no incorrect request behavior is prescribed.
